newsitem.title: UK: Turkey's $250 mln 5-year bond due Monday - bankers.
newsitem.headline: Turkey's $250 mln 5-year bond due Monday - bankers.

text.p: Turkey's long-awaited Eurobond will be launched on Monday, bankers close to the deal said on Friday.
"Turkey's $250 million five-year bond via J.P. Morgan and SBC Warburg is due Monday," a syndicate manager said.
Spread talk was in the 340 to 350 basis point area over U.S. Treasury notes, dealers said.
Emerging market syndicate managers said sentiment in the sector had improved, allowing for the launch of the bond.
Turkey was expected to issue a $250 million five-year Eurobond around mid-April, but the government postponed the deal, citing volatility in the U.S. Treasury market.
Turkey already held roadshows in key financial centres in Europe, Asia and the United States in April.
International credit rating agencies recently cut Turkey's debt rating. The country has a B rating from Standard and Poor's and B1 from Moody's.
